title: 9 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Cough
description: Achillea millefolium essential oils, commonly known as yarrow, have been traditionally used to treat cough and other respiratory issues. The analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties of this herbal preparation help to relieve cough symptoms by reducing inflammation in the throat and lungs.
